name: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform
description: Credentials for an AWX or Ansible Automation Platform controller, injected under all three variable generations that collection has shipped.

fields.label: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform
fields.help_text: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform base URL to authenticate with.

fields.label: Username
fields.help_text: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform username id to authenticate as. This should not be set if an OAuth token is being used.

fields.label: OAuth Token
fields.help_text: An OAuth token to use to authenticate with. This should not be set if username and password are being used.

fields.label: Request Timeout
fields.help_text: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the host. Defaults to 10s
